title: Technical Architect (ServiceNow)
description:
We are looking for a **ServiceNow Technical Architect** who is passionate about designing and delivering enterprise\-scale ServiceNow solutions that drive operational efficiency, platform scalability, and business transformation. This role will provide technical leadership across architecture, integrations, automation, and platform engineering while partnering with business and technology stakeholders to deliver secure, scalable, and upgrade\-safe solutions.### **About You – Experience, Education, Skills, and Accomplishments**

* 12\+ years of overall IT experience with 10\+ years of ServiceNow expertise and at least 3 years in a ServiceNow Architect role.
* Strong experience designing and implementing enterprise\-scale ServiceNow solutions, including architecture, governance, and technical strategy.
* Deep expertise in CMDB, ServiceNow Discovery, ITSM, and ITOM, including data quality, CI relationships, integrations, and infrastructure discovery.
* Hands\-on experience with Integration Hub, Flow Designer, REST/SOAP APIs, MID Servers, Service Graph Connectors, and enterprise integrations.
* Excellent stakeholder management, communication, problem\-solving, leadership, and mentoring skills, with the ability to influence technical decisions.
**It Would Be Great If You Also Had*** Experience with Hardware Asset Management (HAM) and Software Asset Management (SAM) modules.
* Exposure to Now Assist and AI\-powered ServiceNow capabilities.
* ServiceNow Certified Technical Architect (CTA) certification or equivalent advanced ServiceNow certifications.
* Experience supporting large\-scale digital transformation, cloud, or infrastructure modernization programs.
* Experience working in global, cross\-functional, and distributed teams within complex enterprise environments.

### **What Will You Be Doing in This Role**

* Define and drive the ServiceNow architecture roadmap, technical standards, governance framework, and platform strategy.
* Lead solution design, architecture reviews, and technical decision\-making to ensure scalable, secure, and upgrade\-safe implementations.
* Provide architectural leadership across CMDB, Discovery, ITSM, ITOM, integrations, automation, and platform engineering initiatives.
* Collaborate with Enterprise Architects, Product Owners, Business Stakeholders, and Delivery Teams to align technology solutions with business objectives.
* Mentor engineering teams, promote best practices, and identify opportunities to optimize platform performance, governance, and operational efficiency.

At Clarivate, we are committed to providing equal employment opportunities for all qualified persons with respect to hiring, compensation, promotion, training, and other terms, conditions, and privileges of employment. We comply with applicable laws and regulations governing non\-discrimination in all locations.

title: Senior Computer Scientist - C++
description:
The Opportunity
  
Adobe builds products that power millions of customer experiences worldwide. Behind these products are sophisticated software systems operating at scale, where performance, reliability, security, and engineering excellence are fundamental requirements.
  
We are looking for a Senior Computer Scientist with deep C\+\+ expertise who enjoys solving complex technical problems and taking ownership of significant areas of the product. You will shape architecture, build high\-performance software, make critical technical decisions, and influence solutions that span components and teams.
  
We value engineers who are self\-driven, proactive, and outcome\-oriented — engineers who challenge assumptions, solve problems at their root, make pragmatic tradeoffs, and take responsibility for making the systems they own better, more reliable, and easier to evolve.
  
  

What You'll Do
  
Own and evolve significant technical areas end\-to\-end — from understanding ambiguous problems and defining the right solution through architecture, implementation, production validation, and long\-term evolution.
  
Design and build high\-performance C\+\+ systems , making thoughtful decisions around architecture, concurrency, memory management, resource utilization, and scalability.
  
Drive technical direction for complex problems — evaluate alternatives, make pragmatic tradeoffs, and influence architecture decisions across components and teams.
  
Solve problems at the root — identify systemic causes rather than treating symptoms, and drive durable solutions that reduce recurring issues and technical debt.
  
Own outcomes, not just tasks — proactively identify gaps, risks, and opportunities and drive them to closure with minimal direction.
  
Solve complex problems across boundaries , collaborating with engineers, architects, product managers, and other teams to deliver cohesive solutions.
  
Raise the engineering bar through architecture and code reviews, performance optimization, testing, and engineering best practices.
  
Build for operational excellence with strong focus on performance, reliability, security, observability, maintainability, and efficient resource utilization.
  
Be a force multiplier — mentor engineers, share technical expertise, and establish patterns and practices that improve the broader engineering organization.
  
Leverage AI\-assisted engineering to accelerate development and problem solving, improve engineering workflows, and increase team productivity.
  
  

What You Need to Succeed
  
B.Tech/M.Tech in Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
  
10\+ years of hands\-on software engineering experience , with a strong track record of owning and delivering complex technical solutions.
  
Deep expertise in C\+\+ , including modern C\+\+, memory management, concurrency, multithreading, STL, and performance optimization.
  
Strong foundation in data structures, algorithms, object\-oriented design, operating systems, and computer science fundamentals .
  
Strong understanding of systems design, distributed systems, concurrency, scalability, and performance engineering .
  
Experience designing and building large\-scale, high\-performance software systems .
  
Experience building or operating Distributed systems at scale , with an understanding of multi\-tenancy, scaling, reliability, backward compatibility, security, observability, and capacity planning.
  
Strong experience with performance analysis and optimization , including profiling CPU, memory, I/O, latency, and resource utilization.
  
Experience with cloud platforms, distributed infrastructure, and modern software development practices.
  
Strong proficiency in AI\-assisted engineering , leveraging tools such as Claude, Codex, or Copilot to accelerate development, improve problem solving, and enhance engineering productivity.
  
Strong technical judgment and problem\-solving ability , with the ability to navigate ambiguity and influence technical decisions across teams.
  
  

What Success Looks Like
  
Success in this role is not measured only by the features you deliver. You will be successful when you:
  
Own and evolve significant technical areas with minimal direction and strong technical judgment.
  
Turn ambiguous, complex problems into clear technical direction and executable solutions .
  
Make architecture decisions that balance performance, scalability, reliability, maintainability, and long\-term evolution .
  
Solve systemic problems at their root and eliminate recurring sources of complexity, performance issues, and operational risk.
  
Influence technical direction across teams and organizational boundaries through technical depth and credibility.
  
Deliver solutions that materially improve performance, scalability, reliability, quality, or developer productivity .
  
Raise the technical bar through mentorship, design leadership, and engineering practices that benefit the broader organization.
  
About Adobe
  
Adobe empowers everyone to create through innovative platforms and tools that unleash creativity, productivity and personalized customer experiences. Adobe’s industry\-leading offerings including Adobe Acrobat Studio, Adobe Express, Adobe Firefly, Creative Cloud, Adobe Experience Platform, Adobe Experience Manager, and GenStudio enable people and businesses to turn ideas into impact, powered by AI and driven by human ingenuity.
  
  

Our 30,000\+ employees worldwide are creating the future and raising the bar as we drive the next decade of growth. We’re on a mission to hire the very best and believe in creating a company culture where all employees are empowered to make an impact. At Adobe, we believe that great ideas can come from anywhere in the organization. The next big idea could be yours.
  
  

Let’s Adobe together
  
At Adobe, we believe in creating a company culture where all employees are empowered to make an impact. Learn more about Adobe life, including our values and culture , focus on people, purpose and community , Adobe for All , comprehensive benefits programs , the stories we tell , the customers we serve, and how you can help us advance our mission of empowering everyone to create.
  
  

Adobe is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity employer. We do not discriminate based on gender, race or color, ethnicity or national origin, age, disability, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic. Learn more.
  
  

Adobe aims to make our Careers website and recruiting process accessible to any and all users. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation to navigate our website or complete the application process, email accommodations@adobe.com .
  
  

**AI Use Guidelines for Interviews:**  

Our interviews are designed to reflect your own skills and thinking. The use of AI or recording tools during live interviews is not permitted unless explicitly invited by the interviewer or approved in advance as part of a reasonable accommodation. If these tools are used inappropriately or in a way that misrepresents your work, your application may not move forward in the process.

title: Business Architect
description:
**Business Architect**

**Location:** Hapur, Uttar Pradesh, India  
**Work Arrangement:** On\-site  
**Contract:** Full\-time

**About GCRS Group**

GCRS Group is a global regulatory consultancy working across cosmetics, fragrance, personal care, food supplements, medical devices and other regulated consumer products.

As GCRS continues to expand across international markets and strengthen its technology, digital products and operational capabilities, we are seeking a **Business Architect** to help shape the way the organization operates and grows.

This position sits at the intersection of business strategy, operations and technology. The successful candidate will examine how different functions work together, identify opportunities for improvement and help create practical structures that support the company's long\-term objectives.

This role offers an opportunity to work on genuine business challenges, influence decision\-making and contribute to the development of processes and systems that can support GCRS as it scales.

**The Role**

The Business Architect will work with management and teams across regulatory, commercial, operations, technology and product functions to understand business priorities and translate them into workable solutions.

You will examine existing processes, systems and operating models, challenge areas that are no longer effective and help design better ways of working.

Some projects may involve technology implementation or digital transformation, while others may focus on organisational structure, workflow design, process improvement or business planning. The ability to understand the wider business context while paying attention to operational details will be important.

This is a practical role for someone who enjoys solving complex business problems and can move confidently between strategic conversations and detailed process discussions.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Review existing business processes and workflows to understand what is working well and where teams may be facing unnecessary delays, duplication or inefficiencies.
* Work with stakeholders to understand business objectives and turn those objectives into clear, realistic and actionable requirements.
* Help develop business architecture frameworks and operating models that support the company's current needs while allowing room for future growth.
* Look for practical ways to improve productivity, reduce manual work and make business processes easier to manage and scale.
* Map key business functions, processes, capabilities and information flows to create a clear picture of how different areas of the organisation connect.
* Work with management to convert broader business strategies into structured initiatives, priorities and implementation plans.
* Identify gaps between the way a process works today and what the business will need in the future as GCRS expands.
* Prepare clear business requirements for software, digital transformation and technology\-related projects.
* Work closely with software developers, AI engineers, data specialists and product teams to ensure that technology solutions address genuine business requirements.
* Contribute to the development and improvement of digital products and technology\-enabled services offered by GCRS.
* Assess existing processes and systems and recommend where technology could make operations more efficient or improve the client experience.
* Explore opportunities to introduce automation and AI where they can deliver meaningful improvements rather than adding unnecessary complexity.
* Create process maps, workflows, business models and functional requirements that can be easily understood by both business and technical teams.
* Understand how changes to one business function or system may affect other departments, processes, data or client\-facing activities.
* Support teams in designing and introducing new processes that are practical, clearly documented and easy for employees to adopt.
* Help GCRS build scalable operating structures that can support increasing clients, services, markets and internal teams.
* Review business performance and operational information to identify areas where processes, resources or systems could be improved.
* Prepare business cases, recommendations and supporting analysis for new projects, systems and strategic initiatives.
* Help management assess and prioritise business and technology projects based on their potential value, urgency, complexity and business impact.
* Bring relevant stakeholders together to clarify project objectives, define scope and ensure that expectations are aligned before implementation begins.
* Act as a bridge between business teams and technical teams, helping both sides understand requirements, limitations and expected outcomes.
* Identify operational risks, process gaps and areas where the current way of working may create challenges as the business grows.
* Support the implementation of new processes and help teams adapt to changes in systems, technology and ways of working.
* Maintain clear documentation covering business processes, requirements, workflows, operating models and key business decisions.
* Review the results of implemented solutions and recommend further improvements where the expected business outcomes have not been fully achieved.
* Keep up to date with developments in AI, automation, digital transformation and modern business architecture practices that could be relevant to GCRS.

**What We Are Looking For**

The ideal candidate will have a strong interest in understanding how businesses function and how they can operate more effectively.

The candidate should be comfortable asking challenging questions, examining information from different sources and developing a clear view of a problem before recommending a solution.

The position requires someone who can understand the priorities of senior management while remaining close enough to day\-to\-day operations to recognise practical issues that may otherwise be overlooked.

Commercial awareness, sound judgement and the ability to communicate clearly will matter as much as technical knowledge.

We are looking for a person who can connect **business strategy, operational requirements and technology** without losing sight of the people who ultimately use the processes and systems.

**Essential Experience and Skills**

* A degree or professional background in business architecture, business analysis, consulting, strategy, operations, information systems or a related discipline.
* Strong knowledge of business processes, organisational structures and operating models, with the ability to assess how they function in practice.
* Proven capability in gathering requirements through stakeholder interviews, workshops, meetings and process reviews.
* A structured approach to analysing complex problems and breaking them into manageable areas for action.
* Confidence in documenting business processes and explaining them clearly to both technical and non\-technical audiences.
* Practical knowledge of workflow design, process mapping and requirements documentation.
* An understanding of how technology systems support business activities and how changes in one area can affect others.
* The ability to collaborate effectively with people from different departments, levels of seniority and professional backgrounds.
* Skill in converting business needs into clear functional requirements that development or implementation teams can act upon.
* Familiarity with digital transformation concepts and the role technology can play in changing established business models.
* Working knowledge of project delivery and organisational change, particularly where new systems or processes are being introduced.
* A problem\-solving mindset with the ability to recognise inefficiencies and propose realistic improvements.
* Excellent written and verbal communication, including the ability to present findings and recommendations to senior stakeholders.
* Strong organisational skills for managing multiple initiatives, stakeholder discussions and competing priorities.
* Commercial understanding of how operational decisions affect cost, efficiency, customer experience and business growth.

**Desirable Experience**

* Exposure to management consulting, strategic advisory or business transformation projects can provide useful experience for this position.
* Familiarity with AI and automation initiatives will help when assessing opportunities to modernise existing workflows.
* Knowledge of business process management platforms can assist with analysing and redesigning complex operational activities.
* Experience with CRM, ERP or other enterprise business systems.
* Participation in digital transformation programmes and knowledge of enterprise architecture.
* Familiarity with BPMN or another recognised process\-modelling methodology
* Experience preparing transformation roadmaps or investment proposals.
* Exposure to data, reporting and analytics projects.

**What Success Will Look Like**

Within the first six months, you will have:

* Developed a clear understanding of GCRS's major functions, services, workflows and operating structure.
* Produced meaningful process documentation for selected areas of the business where greater clarity or consistency is required.
* Presented management with a prioritised view of operational improvement opportunities.
* Identified specific activities where automation or AI could deliver measurable business value.
* Supported the requirements and planning stages of selected technology initiatives.
* Established productive working relationships between business stakeholders and technical teams.
* Contributed to the design of processes that can accommodate future growth without creating unnecessary operational complexity.
* Provided practical recommendations based on stakeholder feedback, process analysis and available business information.
* Assisted with at least one significant business transformation or technology\-enabled improvement initiative.
* Introduced a more structured approach to capturing business requirements, process changes and solution decisions.
* Demonstrated measurable improvements in selected areas of efficiency, workflow clarity or cross\-functional coordination.

**Why Join Us?**

GCRS is entering an exciting phase of growth, with increasing international activity alongside investment in technology, AI and digital capabilities.

The Business Architect will have the opportunity to work across multiple areas of the organisation rather than being restricted to a single department or system.

The candidate will gain direct exposure to management and collaborate with regulatory, commercial, operations, technology and product teams. The role is particularly suited to someone who wants to build something rather than simply maintain an existing structure. As the company's technology and operating capabilities develop, there will be scope to take on greater responsibility across business transformation, strategy and technology.

**Important**

This is a **fully on\-site role** based at the GCRS office in **Hapur, Uttar Pradesh.** Candidates must be willing to work from the Hapur office **five days a week**.

Work Location: In person
